item.title: Former country club to be transformed into nature preserve
item.description: The city of Fairlawn is transforming a former private golf course into the 66-acre Rosemont Preserve, a $7 million project designed to reduce flooding while adding walking trails, wetlands, and community spaces.

item.title: FBI searches home west of Nancy Guthrie's house
item.description: FBI agents searched a home west of Nancy Guthrie’s house as the investigation entered Day 32.

item.title: 'I couldn't save my daughter': Father of girl buried in suitcase speaks for first time
item.description: FOX 8 is hearing from the father of one of two young girls killed and buried in shallow graves in Collinwood, discovered Monday night.

item.title: FORECAST: Temperatures pushing 70? In winter?
item.description: Scattered showers will dissipate through the course of Thursday evening and much of them will be gone by 8 p.m. Even though the rain will move on, the fog will stay. Some of it could be dense at times.

item.title: 911 recordings: Callers frustrated by New Year's gunfire -- what can be done?
item.description: New recordings released to the FOX 8 I-Team show outrage as so many of you called 911, and you weren't getting help even with wild gunfire in the streets to celebrate the New Year.

item.title: US military sets Iranian drone carrier ship on fire
item.description: The U.S. military struck and set on fire an Iranian drone carrier ship Thursday as forces continue to degrade the Islamic Republic’s navy and continue pummeling the nation with missiles and bombs.

item.title: Mother charged with murder after girls found dead in suitcases
item.description: Charges are expected to be filed soon connected to the deaths of two young girls found dead earlier this week buried in suitcases.

item.title: Did you feel it? Earthquake detected in Lake County
item.description: A 2.9 magnitude earthquake was detected Lake County on Thursday evening, the U.S. Geological Society reported.

item.title: Akron police seeking answers after Barberton grad killed in hit-and-run
item.description: Akron police are asking for the public's help to identify the driver of an SUV involved in a hit-and-run accident that claimed the life of a 23-year-old pedestrian.

item.title: Neighbors react after mother charged with daughters' murders, one saying 'something seemed off'
item.description: The mother of two young girls found buried in suitcases on Monday night has been arrested and charged with their deaths.
